visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark, straight hair sits still with eyes closed in a brightly lit studio. A makeup artist's hands enter the frame, using silver tweezers to precisely shape his eyebrows. He is draped in a black waterproof salon cape that covers his shoulders and chest, over a blue patterned inner layer. The background is a minimalist indoor space featuring white-painted brick walls and a metal rack holding various dark garments. (2) The makeup artist continues the facial preparation, applying dabs of skin-colored product using their fingertips and a small precision brush around the man's eyes and cheeks. The man occasionally opens his eyes, looking directly ahead with a calm, neutral expression. Bright, professional studio lighting illuminates his skin, highlighting the damp texture of the newly applied makeup. Pink and white text captions are overlaid on the lower third of the screen. (3) The scene shifts to hair styling. A stylist wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and a green surgical mask uses a black flat iron to curl sections of the man's hair. Another hand holds a round wooden brush to add volume. The man has removed the black cape, now clearly displaying a blue denim-like robe decorated with vibrant yellow, pink, and green floral and geometric icons. The studio background remains consistent with white pipes visible on the ceiling. (4) In a series of fast-cut selfie-style clips, the man poses in front of a large mirror. He holds a purple foldable Samsung smartphone horizontally to capture his reflection. He first appears in the colorful blue robe, then quickly transitions into a dark, structured high-collar jacket and faded blue jeans. The lighting casts a slight shadow on the back wall, and a green tote bag and a backpack are visible on a stool and on the floor in the background.
